Leah: Heads-up: running bringup tests for codexica-36k int4 and hit a repeat/shift that looks like a small loop at a stitchpoint. Only on long prefills (>30k) and reproducible on our staging build.
Omar: can you paste the exact command you used?
Leah: sure:```bash
./test_runner --model codexica-36k-int4 --context 36000 --prefill-file tests/prefill_30k.txt --dump-kv --rotary-scale 1.0 --log debug
```
Leah: observed text delta (humanified): reference: "...the motion carried without objection." -> int4: "...the motion carried without objection. without objection." (duplicate phrase inserted; later tokens shifted).
Devon: interesting. duplicate suggests we replayed a small kv window during reattach rather than skipping. do you have token ids around stitch?
Leah: yes, dumped ids around idx 31221: pre-attach window [31218,31219,31220,31221,31222] then after reattach stream shows [31218,31219,31220,31220,31221,31222] (duplicate 31220).
Omar: that is a repeat. if fp16/int8 don't reproduce then it's likely a quant packing/handshake edge. did you run controls?
Leah: ran fp16 -> no duplicate. int8 -> intermittent, int4 -> deterministic.
bench-bot: scheduled full-eval codexica-36k-int4-longprefill #88 (staging) https://ci.internal/runs/88 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Devon: could be two things: (A) index arithmetic overflow/clamp in the int4 packer, or (B) a comparator fold in the KV handshake that wrongly maps a boundary case to previous index. Any KV fingerprints?
Leah: dumped kv fingerprints: `fp_before=7c4d11f2`, `fp_after=7c4d11f3` 1-bit flip at stitch. logs show `HANDSHAKE: reattach shard=4 expected_next=31222 got_next=31221` then later `REPLAY: duplicating idx=31220 count=1`
Omar: add `--rotary-scale=0.9998` and `--rotary-scale=1.0002` runs; tiny RoPE scale deltas sometimes change attention ordering enough to flip comparator decisions around quant boundaries.
Leah: will do. also will run a minimized harness to reproduce deterministically. uploading artifacts to ticket ML-2567: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-2567
Devon: plan: 1) run rotary sweep on three quant modes (fp16,int8,int4) collecting kv fingerprints and token id dumps; 2) bisect recent int4 packing commits (start at commit 4e2b7a); 3) add a lightweight suture assertion in KV reattach that rejects repeated ids in staging and logs full memory state.
Omar: I'll own the bisect. Devon, can you add the suture assertion as a configurable guard flag? call it `--kv-suture-strict` and default to off.
Devon: yep. I'll also add a unit test that simulates a mid-token reattach with randomized boundary values to catch packing edgecases.
Leah: quick note: when I forced `--rotary-scale=1.0003` the repeat disappeared for this prompt but appeared on a different prompt in the batch. so sensitivity is real but not uniform.
bench-bot: matrix job queued: longprefill-stitch-matrix #89 (expected 2.5h). results will upload to ML-2567 artifacts.
Omar: syncing on this tomorrow 11am PT to decide whether to revert packing change or add runtime guard.
Leah: thanks team, will post the minimized repro and raw kv blobs once the matrix finishes. :thumbsup:
